solution.title: Microsoft Defender XDR Deployment & Unified Onboarding

products.name: Microsoft Defender XDR Deployment & Unified Onboarding — Commercial
products.short_description: Turn on the whole Microsoft XDR stack — onboard Endpoint, Identity, Office, and Cloud Apps into one unified Defender portal.
products.description:
Turn on the whole Microsoft XDR stack — onboard Endpoint, Identity, Office, and Cloud Apps into one unified Defender portal.

Most tenants own Defender XDR but run it as disconnected point products, so cross-domain attacks slip between the seams. This solution onboards all four pillars — Defender for Endpoint, Identity, Office 365, and Cloud Apps — into the unified portal at security.microsoft.com, turns on cross-pillar incident correlation, and sets unified RBAC and secure score.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Defender for Endpoint onboarding (Intune/GPO/script) and device coverage
  • Defender for Identity sensors on domain controllers / AD FS
  • Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps activation
  • Unified incident correlation across all pillars in one portal
  • Unified RBAC roles and Secure Score baseline

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

One correlated XDR portal that sees an attack move identity → endpoint → email → cloud, instead of four consoles that each see a fragment.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • DEFXDR-Discovery.ps1 — read-only readiness for onboarding the four Microsoft Defender XDR
    • DEFXDR-Hunt.ps1 — run the cross-pillar correlation advanced-hunting query to confirm all four
    • DEFXDR-Onboard-DeviceRing.ps1 — assign the Intune EDR onboarding profile to the pilot device
    • DEFXDR-Report.ps1 — coverage + Secure Score report across the Defender XDR pillars, with drift
    • DEFXDR-Validate.ps1 — per-pillar validation that each Defender XDR pillar is onboarded and

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
